**Finding resubmitted: compliant** — no redline, no counterparty comment.

The verifier's two failing checks (duration ≤12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) were artifacts of measuring a clause that does not exist, so the repair was to document the absence more rigorously rather than to change the classification. I added the keyword-sweep evidence to the rationale:

- "solicit" and "induce" — zero hits
- "hire" / "employ" / "personnel" — all hits unrelated: third-party indemnity (p0051, p0052), confidentiality handling by employees (p0056, p0061), independent-contractor status (p0066), authorized-personnel data access (p0035, p0045)
- Survival list in p0070 contains no restrictive covenant

Since nothing restricts our ability to hire or approach Vendor personnel, the agreement sits at the **preferred** position, and a compliant finding correctly carries no redline. The fallback terms remain recorded as internal guidance in case the Vendor tries to add a non-solicit on redraft.
